description: Hi! I’m Taimour, a CS undergrad (FUUAST, Islamabad) focused on trustworthy AI for health data. I’ve done 4 AI/ML internships and build models that explain their decisions and flag when they’re unsure. We’ll build an astronaut health monitor that spots anomalies in vitals (heart rate, SpO2, sleep) and explains every alert. Looking for: a frontend/dashboard dev (React or Streamlit), someone into biomedical or space-health data, and a designer for our demo video. Let’s build!
